Name: Basic
Description: This pet food recipe has been carefully designed to give balanced nutrition to many smaller creatures. Includes plant fibers to help with digestion and egg to bind the mix. Humans have difficulty digesting this.

Components.Name: Cooked Meat
Components.Description: Sates your hunger and provides health while being digested. Wild carnivores will eat it, but prefer raw meat.

Components.Name: Amarberry
Components.Description: This yellow berry grows mostly on the beaches. Tasty, and can be used to make yellow dye.

Components.Name: Mejoberry
Components.Description: This wild berry grows mostly on mountains. While not tasty on its own, its juices improve almost every meal.

Components.Name: Tintoberry
Components.Description: This red berry grows mostly in wide open grasslands. Tasty, and can be used to make red dye.

Components.Name: Fiber
Components.Description: Delicately collected strands of plant. Perfect for making thread, cloth, or rope.

Components.Description: Sates your hunger SLIGHTLY, and provides health while being digested. Wild carnivores will eat it, but prefer raw meat.

Components.Name: Rockarrot
Components.Description: This root vegetable seems to thrive near mammals, and not dinosaurs. As such, it can be found mostly in the mountains.

Name: Regular
Description: This specially blended pet food is a favorite of many medium creatures. Containing only the finest natural ingredients, it provides pets with the balanced nutrition they need. And with a taste they can't resist, they'll warm up to you in no time! Not intended for human consumption.

Components.Name: Cooked Meat Jerky
Components.Description: Sates your hunger and provides health while being digested. Lasts longer than cooked meat. Wild carnivores will eat it, but prefer raw meat.

Components.Name: Longrass
Components.Description: This grain plant grows best in open, fertile areas. It can be eaten by the cob but more clever chefs will think of other options.

Components.Name: Savoroot
Components.Description: This starchy tuber grows naturally in densely wooded areas. It is very hearty, but tastes better when cooked.

Components.Name: Fiber
Components.Description: Delicately collected strands of plant. Perfect for making thread, cloth, or rope.

Name: Superior
Description: This specially blended pet food is a favorite of many larger creatures. Containing only the finest natural ingredients, it provides pets with the balanced nutrition they need. And with a taste they can't resist, they'll warm up to you in no time! Not intended for human consumption.

Components.Name: Prime Meat Jerky
Components.Description: Sates your hunger, and provides health while being digested. More effective than normal meat jerky, and lasts longer than Cooked Prime Meat. Wild carnivores like this meat a lot.

Components.Name: Citronal
Components.Description: This citrus fruit grows naturally along the coast. It will probably prevent scurvy.

Components.Name: Sap
Components.Description: A thick blob of unrefined sap.

Components.Name: Rare Mushroom
Components.Description: You feel lightheaded after just touching this. Ingesting it would be dangerous.

Components.Name: Focal Chili
Components.Description: This filling dish is full of nutritional energy. Consume it to gain increased craft speed, and gain increased movement speed. Effects last 15 minutes.

Components.Name: Rare Flower
Components.Description: Even the smell of this flower makes you slightly angry.

Components.Name: Giant Bee Honey
Components.Description: A delicious and nutritious snack, useful for luring creatures to a trap or for fishing.
